label: s1_side02_0040_camera_01
text: OK, so if we just compile the photos we both\ntook...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_02
text: It looks like we’ve photographed every Pokémon\nknown to appear in the forest when it’s foggy![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_03
text: We did it! We really pulled it off! I can’t tell you\nhow much I appreciate this![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_dog_01
text: Grawa!

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_04
text: Now we just send all our data to the Pokémon\nSearcher, and...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_05
text: wait, I guess. It’s supposed to take a little bit for\nall the data to be, uh, processed. Or whatever.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_06
text: You know, the photos you took were all real\ngood, partner. You’ve got an eye for this![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_07
text: So, spill: What were you thinking about most\nwhen you were taking those photos?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_select_01
text: Capturing the Pokémon as they are

label: s1_side02_0040_select_02
text: Showing off the Pokémon’s best sides

label: s1_side02_0040_select_03
text: I wasn’t really thinking about anything...

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_08
text: Trying to capture the Pokémon as they are...\c\nSo you really wanted to show how the Pokémon\nlive, pure and unadulterated, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_09
text: Trying to show off the Pokémon’s best sides...\c\nSo you try to capture those moments when your\nsubject is really shining their brightest, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_10
text: You weren’t thinking about anything, huh?\c\nI guess you were just capturing the world around\nyou with the natural instincts of a born artist.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_11
text: I, uh...I’m actually in a bit of slump myself.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_12
text: Even a kid like you knows what a slump is, right?\nLike, when nothing seems to go right for you.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_13
text: You might not believe it, but when I was younger,\nI was lauded as a photography prodigy...\r\nEveryone loved my photos! Absolutely everyone![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_14
text: But in these past few years, I feel like I’ve lost my\nspark—and my photos show it. They lack heart.\r\nThe awards have all dried up. The accolades too.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_15
text: And the longer it keeps dragging on...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_16
text: the more I lose sight of what it is I even want to\ncapture with my photos.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_dog_02
text: Grawww...?

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_17
text: That’s when I heard the stories about the\nBloodmoon Beast.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_18
text:
I left for Kitakami as fast as I could—I thought
that if I could just get a photo of an astounding
Pokémon like that, then maybe, just maybe...
something inside me would change.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_select_04
text: It’ll be OK!

label: s1_side02_0040_select_05
text: That’s rough...

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_19
text: Thanks, partner. And sorry. I didn’t mean to bring\nthe whole mood down with my problems.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_20
text: “That’s rough”? Hahaha! That’s all you’ve got?\nYou’re not very good at this comfort thing, kid.\r\nHahahaha, oh man, that killed me...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_system_01
text: *dingle-dee-dee-dootle*

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_21
text: Oh, I guess the machine’s done doing its thing.\nBut...that jingle...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_22
text: I’m pretty sure that’s the same one my dryer\nplays when it’s done with a load...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_23
text: Hahaha, too funny! Who decided to use that?\nCan you just give anything a jingle now?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_24
text: Anyway, if we filter out all of our data...\c\nIt looks like there’s still one hit out there in the\nfoggy woods.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_25
text: That’s gotta be the Bloodmoon Beast. We’ve\nfinally found it...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_26
text: Heh. This is it! You know, talking to you really\nhelped me throw off some of that old tension.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_28
text: I think I’m ready to go meet the Bloodmoon\nBeast! How about you, partner? You ready?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_29
text: Yes! Then we’re off![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_30
text:
Looks like your Pokémon Boxes might be full
there, partner.\c
You might want to keep some space open, just
in case, right?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_0040_camera_27
text: Let me know as soon as you’re ready to go meet\nthe Bloodmoon Beast for yourself, then![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
